proposals.before: Men like Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yanshou, and Zhang Chang filled their offices competently, yet built their reputations on harsh law; several ended condemned and put to death.
proposals.after: Men like Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yannian, and Zhang Chang filled their offices competently, yet built their reputations on harsh law; several ended condemned and put to death.
proposals.reason: Chinese 嚴延年 is Yan Yannian; the idiomatic English wrongly repeats Yanshou from Han Yanshou.

proposals.before: Such as Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yanshou, Zhang Chang and their kind, all matched their positions, yet relied on punishments; some met crime and execution.
proposals.after: Such as Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang and their kind, all matched their positions, yet relied on punishments; some met crime and execution.

proposals.before: At the time few could be praised for transforming and governing; only Chancellor of Jiangdu Dong Zhongshu, Imperial Household Grandee Gongsun Hong, and Ni Kuan were worth recording in office.
proposals.after: At the time few could be praised for transforming and governing; only Chancellor of Jiangdu Dong Zhongshu, Imperial Household Grandee Gongsun Hong, and □ Kuan were worth recording in office.
proposals.reason: Chinese has □寬 with the surname character missing; literal invents the surname Ni.

proposals.reason: 伊尹 is the personal name Yi Yin, not a 'yiyin day'.

decisions.reason: Focus unit lists 嚴延年 after 尹翁歸; that given name is Yannian (年), not Yanshou (壽). The prior idiomatic wrongly copies Han Yanshou's given name onto Yan. The proposed replacement restores the correct name without other changes.
Focus unit 嚴延年 is Yan Yannian; the prior literal renders him as Yan Yanshou by contamination from adjacent 韓延壽. Correcting only that name matches the Chinese.
